(2) span - YES, second. 136 files, 16,254 rows, but 70 distinct headers and column counts from 61 to 79, because the column set follows each cruise's sensor suite. (3) xmlcoeff - NOT YET. 136 files but 40 distinct headers, 1 to 198 columns, and three files with a single column (apparently empty or truncated). These are per-cruise sidecars of calcofi_ctd-cast, not a separate dataset, so a new ingest_*.qmd would mint a dataset_key and a release shard for something that is not one.
